title.narrative: Preparatory Study for Empowerment of Young Syrian Refugees in Lebanon

description.narrative: After carrying out a successful pilot project in 2022 between Ung Mosaik and ECY, the two organizations desire a preparatory study to investigate the opportunities for a future project. The target group and three main focuses of a future project are: 1. Organizational development through focusing on strengthening the mental health of the leaders and training new leaders. 2. Activities and classes for the youth of Bourj Hammoud. 3. Advocacy with a focus on ethnic and gender equality, learning youth to use their voice, and changing the view of Syrian refugees in society. Through interviews, focus groups, and workshops with our target group, the teenagers, and the leaders we will reach our objectives. During the preparatory study, we seek to clarify how to draw on experiences from the pilot project and prepare to apply for a partnership project.
